The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: (of the weather) very warm.

notes: Use caluroso for hot weather or a warm, welcoming person, but do not use it for things that feel hot to the touch (use caliente for that).

senses.definition: Dicho del tiempo o de un lugar, en que hace mucho calor.

examples.text: Hoy hace un día muy caluroso en la playa.
examples.translation: Today is a very hot day at the beach.
examples.emotion: sweating under the bright sun, seeking shade with relief

senses.definition: Que muestra afecto, entusiasmo o acogida amable.

examples.text: Recibimos una acogida calurosa por parte de la familia.
examples.translation: We received a warm welcome from the family.
examples.emotion: smiling and feeling deeply appreciated upon arrival
